input.title: The Connect image is nginx:alpine serving a SPA built at image-build time and running as UID 101, so there is no Node or ph CLI in the container and packages load in the browser from the registry

input.description: Entrypoint: render nginx config via envsubst (PORT=3001, PH_CONNECT_BASE_PATH), deep-merge PH_CONNECT_CONFIG_JSON, re-sync the CSP registry origin, nginx -t, start. Packages load in the browser.

Extracted from docs/plans/2026-08-24-docker-compose-channels-design.md at v6.2.2-dev.74 — Common service shape: connect port 3001, wget healthcheck

input.content:
The Connect target is **nginx:alpine serving the static SPA** — the frontend is built at **image build time** (`ph connect build`), not at container start, so the container has no Node.js and no `ph` CLI. It runs as the non-root `nginx` user (UID 101), which lets pods set `runAsNonRoot: true`; bind-mounted files must be readable by UID 101 (`chown -R 101:101`). Switchboard, by contrast, runs as root.

At startup the entrypoint:

1. Renders the nginx config from `nginx.conf.template` via envsubst (`PORT`, default `3001`; `PH_CONNECT_BASE_PATH`, default `/`)
2. Deep-merges `PH_CONNECT_CONFIG_JSON` into the dist `powerhouse.config.json` (operator-wins)
3. Re-syncs the Content-Security-Policy registry origin in `index.html` to the effective `packageRegistryUrl`
4. Validates the config (`nginx -t`) and starts nginx

Connect does **not** read any database variables — it is a static frontend; connection strings belong on Switchboard. Custom packages load **in the browser at runtime** from the package registry named by the top-level `packageRegistryUrl` (baked in at image build); to change packages or registry per deployment, override those top-level fields through the same env var: `PH_CONNECT_CONFIG_JSON='{"packageRegistryUrl":"https://registry.example","packages":[{"name":"@powerhousedao/todo-demo-package","version":"1.0.0"}]}'`. Because the image is plain nginx, "building a custom Connect image" means overriding runtime config at deploy time or swapping the served files / `nginx.conf.template` — there is nothing to `ph install` into it. The health check is `wget -q --spider http://127.0.0.1:3001/health` (nginx:alpine has no curl).
